data.body: Landed as Gerrit change 3100, commit ad4d48ed8a0, LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. Live alarm and runbook both say 6/3; the HCL description now says 3 of 6. The new drift test failed on voter_errors alone before the edit and passes after. make verify locally: only the 17 known pandoc failures under tests/unit/reconciler; Linux CI green. Review advisories left open on purpose: (1) the claim pattern allows at most 2 words between the number and 'periods' or 'window', a floor on the number of claims found guards against it going blind; (2) the mismatch comparison is exercised by the real tree but has no seeded call that drives it directly. The live CloudWatch text changes only when Terraform is applied; that is the linked P4 task.
